name: Low Light
tagline: A journal about making things for the web.
editor_bio: Writes about design, performance and the habits behind good work, and edits Low Light.
about_title: A small journal for people who make things for the web.
about_intro: Low Light publishes one essay a week on design, engineering and the habits that make both better. We write for people who read at night, on phones, between other things.
contact_text: Write with questions, corrections or an idea for an essay. A short note is plenty.
newsletter_text: The week’s piece in your inbox, with the two links we kept coming back to.

topics.name: Design
topics.blurb: Type, color and layout, tuned for reading comfort.

topics.name: Engineering
topics.blurb: Performance budgets, routing, and code you can read in one sitting.

topics.name: Craft
topics.blurb: Small interface details, from focus rings to empty states.

topics.name: Notes
topics.blurb: Short pieces on working habits and decisions along the way.

principles.title: One idea per piece
principles.text: Each entry argues for a single thing and stops when it has.

principles.title: Numbers we can show
principles.text: We name the thresholds, units and sources we rely on, so you can check them.

principles.title: Readable first
principles.text: Every page is read on a phone, in the dark, before it is published.
